project_type: C++20 Windows DLL proxy (d3d11.dll) for Guild Wars 2 translation overlay
build_system: CMake 3.21+ with vcpkg and MSVC (Visual Studio 2022). CMakePresets.json defines windows-msvc preset.
build_command: Cannot build on Linux host (requires MSVC + vcpkg on Windows). Validate via static analysis of code structure and CMake syntax.
verification_instructions: Verify YAML syntax, CMake syntax, and that triplet x64-windows-static-md is consistently set in all relevant files.
setup_instructions: Windows-only project. Requires: Visual Studio 2022, vcpkg, CMake 3.21+.
environment_constraints: Linux sandbox - cannot compile Windows DLL. Validation limited to syntax checking and structural verification.
contribution_requirements: C++20 style, bronco:: namespace. README in Portuguese (Brazilian).
key_patterns: x64-windows-static-md links all vcpkg deps statically (as .lib) but keeps CRT dynamic (/MD). This means our DLLs embed all third-party code with no external DLL dependencies.
directory_structure: Root: CMakeLists.txt, vcpkg.json, CMakePresets.json. src/: C++ sources. .github/workflows/: CI.
